data.subject: Local Ledger for Graham Capital
data.body:
Hi,

Your most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in ELME and SFBC.

On September 29, 2026, ELME received a delisting or listing-standard notice in an 8-K Item 3.01 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/104894/000010489426000117/elme-20260928.htm)

I publish Local Ledger, an independent research service based only on public records and never issuer-paid. I can send the free weekly issue and set up a four-week fund pilot for your team. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
